_comment: The oldest Linux the Linux x64 player supports. glibc: no libeawr_viewer.linux.template_release.x86_64.so symbol may need a newer GLIBC_ version (tools/offload/linux_glibc_floor.py fails the native viewer leg otherwise). glibcxx: the newest GLIBCXX_ version it may import (a libstdc++ at least that new must be installed; Ubuntu 24.04 ships 3.4.32). The patched Linux editor engine itself needs glibc 2.38.
